<!-- pr-reviewer: 55001e5552185e1afef89aef4e62be281ec4a6fd -->
Needs changes before merge. The local build and tests pass. Two project requirements remain open.

I read the full diff, including the guard from #3990. I checked the project rules against current upstream/main.
The three tokens keep the previous dark and light values. The file loader and draw sites use the new keys correctly.
The extracted `geom_legal` checks keep their previous conditions.

Requested before merge:

1. **Class: missing UI evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/move_handles.rs:21`, `turn_handles.rs:22`, and `crates/ui/src/align_pick_viz.rs:131`: add before/after screenshots to the PR body. The body currently states that no screenshot exists. The review instructions require this evidence for UI changes, including changes that keep the same default values. Show the move handle, turn handle, and picked point. Include dark and light views. Store the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit images to this PR branch.
2. **Class: test placement.** `crates/ui/tests/theme_viewport_inks.rs:1` and `crates/ui/tests/colour_literals.rs:1`: explain each new top-level test binary in the PR body. Current upstream/main requires a one-line reason for each new top-level integration test file. Put the theme tests in the existing `theme_files` directory suite where possible. If a separate binary is necessary, state why. The guard comes from #3990; that PR can supply its reason. Apply this check to both new binaries in this stack.

Local results on the trial merge:

- PR head: `55001e5552185e1afef89aef4e62be281ec4a6fd`.
- Main base: `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`.
- Trial merge: `172f16fa33b9737615b13c556e5b50d71dc2c004`. Its first parent is the PR head. The merge has no conflict.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 12 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The UI test build passed.
- UI library: 1,657 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
- Integration suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 7; `colour_literals` 3; `contour_dxf_sketch` 2; `sinker_setup` 2; `tap_hand` 3; `theme_example` 3; `theme_files` 17; `theme_viewport_inks` 2; `waterjet_tool` 1. No failure.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The release build passed. All 11 selected tests passed: motion library 7; `adaptive_troch_island` 1; `adaptive_troch_neck` 1; `adaptive_troch_parallel` 1; app `pocket_pass_start` 1.
- `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

Extra suites run: the light suites are listed above. The fixture, importer, and example-catalog rules require no additional suite for this diff.

Safety check: this PR changes display colours. It does not change posted G-code, collision checks, gouge checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No mutation run is required. No recorded program or golden file changed. No full heavy lane ran.

Suggested review state: `needs-rework`. I left all labels, the title, and the draft state unchanged, as requested for this run.
The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm. No code was edited or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
